construction: Conditional sudden-release product of independent ground-state harmonic traps at every original cell/atom/Cartesian coordinate; traps define preparation only and are absent from subsequent dynamical C(q).
mass: M_a=atomic_mass_amu[a]*AMU_RY repeated xyz; AMU_RY=amu_si/(2 electronmass_si); tau=t Ry/hbar, p=M du/dtau, [u,p]=i
stiffness: kappa_a=Re C_aa(R=0), using the actual complete seven-axis common force lattice, not Gamma and not an eigenvalue
reality_test: Each |Im kappa_a| <= tolerance*|Re kappa_a|; original raw complex diagonals and residuals are published. Nonpositive real part or material imaginary part raises missing-preparation-input, with no fallback.
hamiltonian: Hprep=sum_cell,a [p_cell,a^2/(2 M_a)+kappa_a u_cell,a^2/2]; omega_a=sqrt(kappa_a/M_a). Means u=p=0 at original coordinates.
state: rho0=rho_electronic_original tensor product over all 64 cells and ionic coordinates |0_kappa><0_kappa|. This is an explicit new preparation hypothesis, not inferred from saved electrons or curvature.

moments.uncertainty: Vuu Vpp - Vup^2 = 1/4 per canonical mode; ordered W=V+i J/2 positive semidefinite
moments.electronic_ionic_connected: zero in both orders by the explicitly declared tensor product, for all electronic observables, including raw-frame off-diagonal bilinears

periodic_convention: u(q)=64^-1/2 sum_R exp(-2pi i q.R) u_R, same for p; no atom-position phase. u(q)^dagger=u(-q); ordered <z(q)z(q')>=delta_(q+q',0) Wlocal, whereas <z(q)z(q')^dagger>=delta_(q,q') Wlocal. q labels are all integer indices/4 modulo 1.
mean_coordinate: bar_z=sum_R z_R/64=z(q=0)/sqrt(64); covariance Wlocal/64 and [bar_u,bar_p]=i/64. It is not a canonical IonicPreparation; p_total=64 bar_p would be conjugate to bar_u.
sources: No new external scientific result: elementary canonical oscillator algebra derived independently with SymPy and finite-Fock vacuum moments. Existing QE Ry mass and lattice Fourier source conventions are reused unchanged and bound by the oracle.
